page_title: BRE 1-3 EVE | Brentford v Everton 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+1' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Oliver didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Substitution. Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Keane Lewis-Potter walks off.
89' James Tarkowski (Everton) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
89' James Garner (Everton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
88' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
86' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Jordan Pickford comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Flag goes up against Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
82' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
80' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Jordan Pickford was alert and made an amazing save!
78' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is flagged for offside.
77' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Amadou Onana and he is replaced by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton).
77' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
76' The linesman signals that Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
73' It will be a substitution. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Aaron Hickey walks off.

71' 1 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from James Garner, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), who beats Mark Flekken with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
70' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
70' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner with a short pass.
69' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) inside the box.

67' 1 - 2 James Tarkowski (Everton) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Dwight McNeil. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:2.
67' Everton will take a corner kick.
63' Substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) replaces Beto.
63' Dwight McNeil (Everton) beats a defender on the edge of the box then bends in an effort at goal, but his radar is way off and the ball sails well wide of the right post.
62' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Vitaly Janelt will be replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
61' The referee signals a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Mads Roerslev Rasmussen.
60' Beto (Everton) latched on to a cross and struck a header just wide of the left post.
58' Amadou Onana (Everton) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
55' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dwight McNeil (Everton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

52' Beto (Everton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Mark Flekken!
50' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
48' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Beto (Everton) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
44' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
40' A pass by Beto (Everton) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' What a huge chance for Beto (Everton). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
34' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game.
30' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brentford players have a reason to celebrate!
29' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Brentford goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
28' 1 - 1 Vitaly Janelt plays a neat ball into the path of Mathias Jensen (Brentford), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the left post! 1:1.
27' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) controls a cross deep inside the box and hits the crossbar!
26' Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
22' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
21' What a wasted opportunity by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Mark Flekken makes a decent save to thwart him.
17' Everton restart play with a quick free kick.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).
14' Dwight McNeil (Everton) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
10' Ashley Young (Everton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
6' 0 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by James Tarkowski and Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 0:1.
6' A corner kick by Everton is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).

5' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Everton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
2' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the direct free kick, but drags his shot well wide of the left post.
2' Brentford are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
1' The referee shows the yellow card to Ashley Young (Everton).
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Michael Oliver was nominated as the referee for this game.
